name: Commune with Texts (Legendary Games)
body:
During the spell’s effect, you add your mythic tier to every Knowledge check made and you can converse with texts twice.

Augmented (5th tier): The spell’s duration decreases to 1 minute per level. For every minute of research, you gain the same benefits you would have gained in an hour.
